targets.expr:
# receivers
label_replace(
  label_join(
    label_join(
      sum(${metric:value}(
        otelcol_receiver_accepted_spans${suffix_total}{job="$job",source="otelcol-telemetry"}[$__rate_interval])
      ) by (receiver)
      , "id", "-rcv-", "transport", "receiver"
    )
    , "title", "", "transport", "receiver"
  )
  , "icon", "arrow-to-right", "", ""
)

# dummy processor
or
label_replace(
  label_replace(
    label_replace(
      (sum(rate({__name__=~"otelcol_process_uptime.*", job="$job",source="otelcol-telemetry"}[$__rate_interval])))

or

max by (normalized_service, scope) (((apm_cardinality_limit{collector_alias=~"(${instance:pipe})", normalized_service="all", scope="route"} or apm_cardinality_limit_ratio{collector_alias=~"(${instance:pipe})", normalized_service="all", scope="route"}) or (apm_cardinality_limit{collector_alias=~"(${instance:pipe})", normalized_service=~"django|postgres", scope="operation"} or apm_cardinality_limit_ratio{collector_alias=~"(${instance:pipe})", normalized_service=~"django|postgres", scope="operation"})) or ((apm_cardinality_limit{collector_alias=~"(${instance:pipe})", normalized_service!~"__other__"} or apm_cardinality_limit_ratio{collector_alias=~"(${instance:pipe})", normalized_service!~"__other__"}) and ((rate(apm_cardinality_grouping_total{collector_alias=~"(${instance:pipe})"}[2m]) > 0) or ((apm_cardinality_tracked or apm_cardinality_tracked_ratio) / (apm_cardinality_limit or apm_cardinality_limit_ratio) >= 0.5))))

100 * (max by (normalized_service, scope) (((apm_cardinality_tracked{collector_alias=~"(${instance:pipe})", normalized_service="all", scope="route"} or apm_cardinality_tracked_ratio{collector_alias=~"(${instance:pipe})", normalized_service="all", scope="route"}) or (apm_cardinality_tracked{collector_alias=~"(${instance:pipe})", normalized_service=~"django|postgres", scope="operation"} or apm_cardinality_tracked_ratio{collector_alias=~"(${instance:pipe})", normalized_service=~"django|postgres", scope="operation"})) or ((apm_cardinality_tracked{collector_alias=~"(${instance:pipe})", normalized_service!~"__other__"} or apm_cardinality_tracked_ratio{collector_alias=~"(${instance:pipe})", normalized_service!~"__other__"}) and ((rate(apm_cardinality_grouping_total{collector_alias=~"(${instance:pipe})"}[2m]) > 0) or ((apm_cardinality_tracked or apm_cardinality_tracked_ratio) / (apm_cardinality_limit or apm_cardinality_limit_ratio) >= 0.5))))) / (max by (normalized_service, scope) (((apm_cardinality_limit{collector_alias=~"(${instance:pipe})", normalized_service="all", scope="route"} or apm_cardinality_limit_ratio{collector_alias=~"(${instance:pipe})", normalized_service="all", scope="route"}) or (apm_cardinality_limit{collector_alias=~"(${instance:pipe})", normalized_service=~"django|postgres", scope="operation"} or apm_cardinality_limit_ratio{collector_alias=~"(${instance:pipe})", normalized_service=~"django|postgres", scope="operation"})) or ((apm_cardinality_limit{collector_alias=~"(${instance:pipe})", normalized_service!~"__other__"} or apm_cardinality_limit_ratio{collector_alias=~"(${instance:pipe})", normalized_service!~"__other__"}) and ((rate(apm_cardinality_grouping_total{collector_alias=~"(${instance:pipe})"}[2m]) > 0) or ((apm_cardinality_tracked or apm_cardinality_tracked_ratio) / (apm_cardinality_limit or apm_cardinality_limit_ratio) >= 0.5)))))

(sum by (normalized_service, scope) (rate(apm_cardinality_grouping_total{collector_alias=~"(${instance:pipe})", normalized_service="all", scope="route"}[2m])) or (0 * max by (normalized_service, scope) (apm_cardinality_limit{collector_alias=~"(${instance:pipe})", normalized_service="all", scope="route"} or apm_cardinality_limit_ratio{collector_alias=~"(${instance:pipe})", normalized_service="all", scope="route"}))) or (sum by (normalized_service, scope) (rate(apm_cardinality_grouping_total{collector_alias=~"(${instance:pipe})", normalized_service=~"django|postgres", scope="operation"}[2m])) or (0 * max by (normalized_service, scope) (apm_cardinality_limit{collector_alias=~"(${instance:pipe})", normalized_service=~"django|postgres", scope="operation"} or apm_cardinality_limit_ratio{collector_alias=~"(${instance:pipe})", normalized_service=~"django|postgres", scope="operation"}))) or (sum by (normalized_service, scope) (rate(apm_cardinality_grouping_total{collector_alias=~"(${instance:pipe})", normalized_service!~"__other__"}[2m])))
